message.content: Keysight Technologies Inc operates in the Technology sector and currently trades at a close of 333.42, which sits above its 50-day average of 325.75 and its 20-day average of 328.90 while remaining below the immediate resistance level of 366.41. The stock is in an uptrend with a session high of 333.82 and a session low of 325.75, supported by strong technical indicators including a 14-day relative strength index of 54.21 and a MACD histogram of 1.17. Financial performance shows an operating margin of 25.0 per cent compared to 17.3 per cent a year earlier, alongside sales growth of 36.5 per cent on a year earlier and 11.1 per cent for the same quarter a year before. Earnings have consistently beaten estimates over eight quarters with the latest surprise reaching 30.56 per cent on a report date of 2026-08-19, reflecting an improving business state read from the quarter to 2026-07-31.
